omit.why: public/favicon.svg is the site's own drawing of the same mark and keeps its signature comment, "Building castles in the sky — Yu and AI." (#33); serving the kit's file would drop it (PR #156)

fonts.licence: SIL OFL 1.1 (the file's own licence string)
fonts.source: https://github.com/rsms/inter (the installed file says Version 4.001;git-9221beed3; where this copy was downloaded from is not recorded)

deploy.on_merge: nothing deploys on merge. zerone.ai is the Cloudflare Pages project zerone-ai, deployed by hand with wrangler pages deploy dist from a clean detached worktree of the merged, CI-verified commit (../README.md, Deploy). Nothing under brand/ is served, so a change here alone changes no served byte
deploy.after_deploy: check new or changed files on the deployment's *.pages.dev URL first, and never request a new path on zerone.ai before it is deployed: Pages answers a missing path with the SPA index and the edge can keep that answer (the icon paths held cached HTML for 4 hours, max-age=14400; /assets/* is immutable). A purge is the zone owner's act. Each release gets a release card (R-008 for this kit)
deploy.rules: /AGENTS.md and /CLAUDE.md: never push to main; a branch named <agent>/<topic>, a pull request, and a merge only after CI has finished green with review comments answered (main's ruleset requires 13 named checks). A production deploy changes a live service and needs Yu's word for it; R-008 went out on Yu's word of 2026-10-27 (ledger artcraft-estate-wiring)

notes: tests/brand-kit.sync.test.ts runs in CI through npm test (tsx --test tests/*.test.ts in dashboard/package.json), which npm run check calls inside npm run build, in the job "TypeScript SDK and dashboard" of /.github/workflows/ci.yml (one of the 13 checks main's ruleset requires). Neither file names the test: the glob picks it up.

site.html lists the four static HTML heads and the four TypeScript modules that write page heads; observer-page.ts serves only non-legacy profiles and /pi/callback/ keeps img-src 'none', so neither carries the icon block.
Every page keeps the site's own theme-color #09090c, the kit's #09090C in lower case.

kit.json records fonts by family and style: Inter SemiBold and JetBrains Mono are bundled with vectorcraft-cli 0.17.0, and Inter Light came from the copy installed on the Studio, so build.fonts names the Studio's Inter-Light.otf (an inference).
